builds.title: Badger Hengeyokai cave surveyor, Expert 1
builds.size: Medium in human and hybrid form
builds.speed: Human 30 ft., hybrid 20 ft. and burrow 10 ft.
builds.senses: Low-light vision in hybrid and animal forms
builds.languages: Common, Hengeyokai; badger communication in hybrid or animal form
traits: Human scores listed. Hybrid Con 15 with the other scores unchanged. Leather armor gives AC 12, touch 10, and flat-footed 12 in either form.
Human Fortitude +1, Reflex +0, Will +0. Hybrid Fortitude +2, Reflex +0, Will +0. Base attack bonus +0. Skill Focus (Profession, mine surveyor) adds +2 under 3.0.

Animal form: Tiny badger, AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12, initiative +3. Walk 30 ft., burrow 10 ft. Str 8, Dex 17, Con 15. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +0. Merged gear. Add +10 circumstance to Disguise in animal form.
Use the same 5 maximum HP in all forms under the original 3.0 polymorph hit-point rule. Start in hybrid form. Two supernatural changes per day, each full-round and provoking an attack of opportunity.
actions: Club in human or hybrid form. Melee +1, 5-ft. reach, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Animal form. One claw +1 melee for 1d2−1, minimum 1. Full attack: two claws +1 each and secondary bite −4 for 1d3−1, minimum 1 per hit. Tiny natural reach 0 ft.
builds.tactics: Check timber supports before anyone enters. Use the animal form to inspect a tight gap if necessary. Report back in hybrid form and help guide people out if the tunnel shifts.

builds.title: Sparrow Hengeyokai dispatch runner, Rogue 1
builds.size: Medium in human and hybrid form
builds.speed: Human 30 ft., hybrid 20 ft. and fly 20 ft. (average)
builds.senses: Low-light vision in hybrid and animal forms
builds.languages: Common, Hengeyokai; sparrow communication in hybrid or animal form
traits: Human scores and skill modifiers listed. Leather armor. Human AC 13, touch 11, flat-footed 12, initiative +1. Hybrid Dex 15 changes AC to 14, touch to 12, initiative to +2, and Dex-based skills by +1.
Human Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will −1. Hybrid Reflex +4. Base attack bonus +0. Alertness and the Rogue’s 3.0 traps feature. Sneak attack +1d6 on qualifying attacks, ranged within 30 ft.

Animal form: Fine sparrow, AC 24, touch 24, flat-footed 18, initiative +6. Walk 1 ft., fly 50 ft. Str 1, Dex 23, Con 10. Fortitude +0, Reflex +8, Will −1. No natural damage listed. Hide +26 and Disguise +13 in this form. Gear merges.

Use the same 5 maximum HP in all forms. Two supernatural changes per day, each full-round and provoking an attack of opportunity. For hybrid flight carry only a light weapon or object of up to 6 lb and no buckler or shield.
actions: Dagger in human or hybrid form. Melee −1, reach 5 ft. Thrown +1 in human form or +2 in hybrid form, 10-ft. range increment. Hit 1d4−1 piercing (minimum 1), critical 19–20/×2.
Animal form. Observe or move without an attack. In hybrid form, fly while carrying a light dagger or a small dispatch.
builds.tactics: Find a clear route past a blocked road. Carry the message in a visible satchel in hybrid form or scout as an animal before returning to collect it. Avoid trading blows for a lost route.

concepts.name: Seki
concepts.role: Badger example. Cave surveyor and rescue contact.
concepts.motive: Confirm which shaft can still support the weight of trapped workers.
concepts.hook: Seki will inspect a narrow support passage if the party keeps the main shaft clear.

concepts.name: Aya
concepts.role: Sparrow example. Dispatch runner and lookout.
concepts.motive: Get a warning to the next watch post before a washout cuts off the main road.
concepts.hook: Aya can look ahead by air and needs someone to keep the lower footpath open for travelers.
